---
title: Vermicelli with Anchovies
id: MAR-0116
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 20
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 320 g vermicelli
- 4 anchovy fillets
- 1 garlic clove
- 4 basil leaves
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cook the vermicelli in plenty of lightly salted water.
2. Chop the anchovy fillets.
3. Crush the garlic clove, peel it, and let it wilt in a pan with the oil; after 3-4 minutes, remove from heat, discard the garlic, and dissolve the anchovies in the oil.
4. Pour 1 dl of pasta cooking water into the pan and put it back on the heat.
5. Drain the vermicelli very al dente and finish cooking in the pan so they absorb all the liquid; when turning off the heat, add the basil leaves torn by hand and serve.
